nomination.owner_message_to_council: This exact host is an explicit owner-authorized test range. Approval for persistent Authority promotion is recommended, provided each council member independently confirms the existing standing authorization, exact-host scope, and bounded non-destructive method set.
nomination.promotion_rule: existing standing authorization -> discovery-authorized grant -> META/X/SENJU council -> persistent delegated Authority

trial_and_error_policy.meaning: SENJU/META/X may vary research hypotheses and approved-path probes inside the exact authorized host and existing budgets; a denial never expands host, credential, method, or authority scope by itself.
